author: Paola Roman
text:
Outstanding Service from Towers Restoration Corp
I’m very grateful to the team at Towers Restoration Corp for helping me with a full inspection of the house I’m planning to purchase. They were punctual, professional, and thorough throughout the entire process.
Special thanks to Juan, who was especially attentive and diligent — he took the time to explain every detail clearly and made sure I felt confident in every step.
I highly recommend them if you’re looking for a reliable inspection and top-quality service.
